title: DeiscamVA
description: Vanilla expansion: Tin, Bronze, Steel, full equipment sets. Features alloying via Crucible Furnace, Steel Golem, functional Fletching, Garden tables, Woodcutter, Luck potions, anvil repairs, rebalanced vanilla recipes, and new villager professions.
body:
# **New Materials & Items**
## The mod introduces a tiered progression system featuring Tin, Bronze, and Steel.
*   Tin: Includes Ore, Raw Tin, Ingot, and Storage Blocks. _Note: textures are based on the old designs for Copper Ore, Raw Iron, and the Gold Block._
*   Copper: Expanded with a full set of Tools and Armor, plus Nuggets (backported from 1.21.9).
*   Bronze: Crafted by alloying. Includes Ingots, Blocks, Nuggets, and a full set of Equipment.
*   Steel: High-tier material. Also includes Ingots, Blocks and Nuggets, but has more powerful Equipment.

![New Blocks and Items](https://i.postimg.cc/zvv2YYPc/1_New_Blocks_and_Items.png)

![Blocks and Items comparsion](https://i.postimg.cc/HsKRHjmr/2_Blocks_and_Items_comparsion.png)

![Equipment comparsion](https://i.postimg.cc/LXXG2PJZ/5_Icons_comparsion.png)

![Armor comparsion](https://i.postimg.cc/2ynsKDqc/6_Armor_comparsion.png)

# **Mechanics & Features**

*   Oxidation: Just like Copper, Bronze blocks oxidize over time, though the process is 2-3 times slower.

![Oxidation comparsion](https://i.postimg.cc/bvYB9n9s/3_Oxidation_comparsion.png)

*   Crucible Furnace: A new functional block used for alloying. It requires a Crucible (which has 4 durability points) to operate.
    *   Alloying Recipes: Combine 1 Tin + 3 Copper to get 3 Bronze ingots, or 1 Coal + 3 Iron to get 3 Steel ingots.
    *   Fuel: Only accepts Coal, Charcoal, Coal Blocks, and Lava Buckets. _Note: Smelting speed is 2x slower than a regular furnace._

![Crucible Furnace](https://i.postimg.cc/02gkrKWD/4_Crucible_Furnace.png)

*   Steel Upgrade: To craft Steel equipment, you must find a rare Smithing Template in Trail Ruins. You can duplicate the template using 7 Iron Ingots and any Terracotta block.

![Steel Upgrade](https://i.postimg.cc/xTxJdDpG/8_Steel_Upgrade.png)

*   Steel Golem: A formidable protector. Similar to the Iron Golem but boasts +20 Armor and deals 12.5-25 damage per hit. _Note: The Steel Golem's texture is inspired by the Iron Golem from A Minecraft Movie (originally featured in a Bedrock Edition event)._

![Steel Golem](https://i.postimg.cc/gcBmXzdd/9_Steel_Golem.png)

# **Equipment Stats**

*   Bronze: A direct upgrade to Copper. It offers durability similar to Iron but functions like "battle-ready" Gold. _Note: Piglins will remain neutral while you wear it!_
*   Steel: A significant upgrade over Iron, bridging the gap between Iron and Diamond.

![Stats comparsion](https://i.postimg.cc/X7hvfDY0/7_Stats_comparsion.png)

## **_UPDATE v1.1.6_**

# **Mechanics & Features**

*   Armor Trims: Tin, Bronze, and Steel ingots can be used as materials for armor trimming at the Smithing Table.
*   Luck Potion: Introduced a brewing process for the Potion of Luck. Brewing a Poisonous Potato creates a Potion of Unluck; combining this with a Fermented Spider Eye results in a Potion of Luck.

![Potion Recipes](https://i.postimg.cc/1XgwgM9v/Update1_Potion_Recipes.png)

*   Anvil Repair: Anvils can now be repaired similarly to Iron Golems. Using an Iron Ingot while holding Shift + Right-Click restores one stage of the anvil's durability.
*   Fletching Table: The block is now functional. Crafting the standard arrow recipe here yields 6 arrows. Replacing the flint with an Iron Ingot increases the output to 8 arrows.

![Fletching Table](https://i.postimg.cc/cHPMBPkP/Update1_Fletching_Table.png)

# **Visual Adjustments**

*   Helmets: Vanilla and modded helmet textures include a nose guard.
*   Bottle o' Enchanting: The texture matches the splash potion bottle shape.

![New icons](https://i.postimg.cc/Jzyr9gpv/Update1_New_icons.png)

## _**UPDATE v1.2.9**_

# **Missing Blocks**

*   Added Wall variants for Stone, Smooth Sandstone, Smooth Red Sandstone, Prismarine Bricks, Dark Prismarine, Quartz, Smooth Quartz, and Purpur.

![Walls](https://i.postimg.cc/BnztYhPF/Update2-Walls.png)

*   Polished Granite, Andesite, and Diorite Expansion:
    *   Added Walls, Buttons, and Pressure Plates.
    *   Added Bricks, Brick Slabs, Brick Stairs, and Brick Walls (including Mossy and Cracked variants).
    *   Added Chiseled variants (Pillar variant for Andesite). _Note: Textures are inspired by or adapted from Minecraft: Dungeons._

![Stone and Bricks](https://i.postimg.cc/8cYqQrRq/Update2-Stone-and-Bricks.png)

*   Nether Blocks Expansion:
    *   Soul Sandstone: A complete set including regular, Cut, Chiseled, Slabs, Stairs, and Walls. _Note: textures are based on the old designs for Sandstone._
    *   Nether Bricks: Added Cracked Slabs, Cracked Stairs, and Cracked Walls.
    *   Red Nether Bricks: Added Cracked (with Slabs/Stairs/Walls), Chiseled, and Fence variants.

![Soul Sandstone](https://i.postimg.cc/g2ymRNqm/Update2-Soul-Sandstone.png)

![Nether Bricks](https://i.postimg.cc/tTjr6NkC/Update2-Nether-Bricks.png)

*   End Blocks Expansion:
    *   End Stone: Added Slabs, Stairs, and Walls.
    *   End Stone Bricks: Added Pillar (texture from Minecraft: Dungeons) and Cracked variants (with Slabs/Stairs/Walls).

![End Stones](https://i.postimg.cc/Fz10kYM1/Update2-End-Stones.png)

*   Other Added Blocks:
    *   Stone Bricks: Added Cracked Slabs, Cracked Stairs, and Cracked Walls.
    *   Bricks: Added Mossy and Cracked variants for Bricks, Slabs, Stairs, and Walls.
    *   Deepslate, Smooth Basalt, Packed Mud, and Quartz Bricks: Added Slabs, Stairs, and Walls.
    *   Cut Sandstone & Cut Red Sandstone: Added Stairs and Walls.

## **_UPDATE v1.3.5_**

# **Visual Adjustments**

*   New Dyes textures for: Gray, Lime, Magenta, Pink, Purple _Note: from 1.21.9 but without boards._

# **Fix Vanilla Recipes**

*   Add new mixing recipes:
    *   Brown: Red + Green OR Red + Blue/Lapis Lazuli + Yellow.
    *   Lime: Blue/Lapis Lazuli + Yellow + White/Bone Meal.
    *   Green: Blue/Lapis Lazuli + Yellow.
    *   Cyan: 2 Blue/Lapis Lazuli + Yellow.
*   Deepslate Overhaul:
    *   Polished Deepslate: Now crafted from Deepslate (instead of Cobbled).
    *   Deepslate variants (Polished, Brick, and Tiles): available from Stonecutter using Deepslate (not Cobbled).
    *   Chiseled Deepslate: Now crafted from 2 Polished Deepslate Slabs (instead of 2 Cobbled Slabs).
*   Other Changes:
    *   Signs: 1 Stick + 1 Plank = 2 Signs.
    *   Pressure Plates: 2 Blocks = 2 Pressure Plates.
    *   Doors: 6 Blocks = 4 Doors (Iron Door: 6 Ingots = 1 Door).
    *   Trapdoors: 6 Blocks = 6 Trapdoors.
    *   Sticks: 2 Planks = 8 Sticks.

# **Mechanics & Features**

*   Woodcutter: Efficiently process your wood! Convert Logs to Stripped Logs, or Planks into Slabs and Stairs.
*   Garden Table: _Note: texture is based on the old designs for Cartography Table._
    *   Grass Block: Dirt + Bone Meal + Wheat Seeds.
    *   Mycelium: Dirt + Bone Meal + Brown/Red Mushroom.
    *   Podzol: Dirt + Bone Meal + Rotten Flesh.

![Woodcutter and Garden Table](https://i.postimg.cc/D09KWhSM/Update3-Woodcutter-and-Garden-Table.png)

*   New Villager Professions:
    *   Lumberjack: Uses the Woodcutter.
    *   Gardener: Uses the Garden Table.
    *   Beekeeper: Uses the Honeycomb Block as a workstation (because cannot be attached to Beehive).

![New Professions](https://i.postimg.cc/tC6jKsf7/Update3-New-Professions.png)

### The mod supports 24 (36) languages:

*   Belarusian
*   Bosnian
*   Croatian
*   Czech
*   Danish
*   Dutch (Netherlands, Belgium)
*   English (USA, UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand)
*   Estonian
*   Finnish
*   French (France, Canada)
*   German (Germany, Austria, Switzerland)
*   Italian
*   Latvian
*   Lithuanian
*   Macedonian
*   Norwegian
*   Polish
*   Portuguese (Portugal, Brazil)
*   Romanian (Romania/Moldova)
*   Slovak
*   Slovene
*   Spanish (Spain, Mexico, Argentina)
*   Swedish
*   Ukrainian
